desc: indexOf returns 0 for the first subscriber, and > 0 skips it, so the first subscriber can never unsubscribe; needs i !== -1
String.replace with a string pattern replaces only the first '-': user-signed-up becomes user_signed-up

match: return JSON.parse(json).map((u) => ({ id: Number(u.id), email: u.email }));
desc: 64-bit ids above 2^53 lose precision in JSON.parse/Number, so different users collide or ids change
Date.UTC months are 0-based but month is 1-12, so every result is a month late (December rolls into next year)
forEach ignores the async callbacks' promises: deliverAll resolves before anything is saved, and a failed save is an unhandled rejection
